def verify_current_formal_parent(raw, value, readiness_raw):
    """One host-readiness row changes; shared production keeps its old source input."""
    parent_row = FORMAL_PARENT
    parent_raw = read(parent_row)
    parent = json.loads(parent_raw)
    need(enc(parent) == parent_raw and enc(value) == raw,
         'exact canonical formal parent and current input required')
    rows = parent['provider_helpers']
    previous = [r for r in rows if r['name'] == 'collect_r10_readiness.py']
    current = [r for r in value['provider_helpers'] if r['name'] == 'collect_r10_readiness.py']
    need(len(previous) == len(current) == 1 and current[0] == dict(
         name='collect_r10_readiness.py', path=FORMAL_CURRENT_READINESS_PATH,
         bytes=len(readiness_raw), sha256=sha(readiness_raw)),
         'current formal readiness row is not this exact reviewed helper')
    reverse = json.loads(raw)
    index = next(i for i, row in enumerate(reverse['provider_helpers'])
                 if row['name'] == 'collect_r10_readiness.py')
    reverse['provider_helpers'][index] = previous[0]
    need(enc(reverse) == parent_raw,
         'formal input changed beyond its one actual host readiness row')
    return parent_row['sha256']
